cand.title: Nyon Chess Weekend 2027
cand.excerpt: Good local sports fit but third-party listing and venue details need verification.
cand.ledgerVenue: Nyon; exact playing hall to be confirmed

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: David Lugeon is the club’s president and playing director, the author of the official Marchissy announcement, and the published adult/correspondence contact. Primary first approach for identity and accommodation questions; hotel contracting control is not established. Jean-Paul Palau is listed as secretary and adult-activities contact: a relevant second organizational route, not a verified housing buyer. Thierry Branca is a further historical Signy registration route: the 2026 tournament page directs late registrations to his published email, but this does not establish a 2027 appointment or purchasing authority.
findings.futureEdition: The seed advertises 29–30 January 2027 in Nyon, but no organizer confirmation of that two-day edition was found. The organizer instead explicitly announces Échecs et mets on Saturday 30 January 2027 in Marchissy, describing it as the date originally planned for the annual Signy tournament. This is an actual activity date, not the July/October 2026 publication/update dates. The official announcement does not establish a Friday blitz, the seed weekend identity, or that Échecs et mets is formally the next Signy edition. Do not merge these records automatically. No official 2028 edition was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: regional chess relationships are geographically more plausible than downtown Geneva megashow housing, but no overnight demand has been established. A one-day chess-and-dining tournament in Marchissy is not evidence for a 20–120-room block, much less the whole 237-room hotel. YOTEL’s meeting/F&B product could be discussed for a future separate club workshop or tournament only if the club wants a new site and chess-table layout, budget and transport work. Theatre capacity is not a chess-board capacity. This is neither a proven resort retreat nor confirmed airport-corridor lodging.
findings.venueCommitments: Seed event: exact venue unverified; Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland is only the third-party location. Related official Échecs et mets event: Marchissy is organizer-confirmed; Chessmates, attributing its entry to the Swiss federation calendar, specifies Auberge LaMarmite, Place Du Tilleul 6, 1261 Marchissy. That exact venue remains secondary-source supported, not directly organizer-verified in the retrieved text. The venue describes itself as the restaurant of the Auberge de Marchissy in La Côte/Jura Vaudois: regional Vaud/Jura-side demand, not Geneva city or Lausanne. A listing is not evidence of an executed venue contract. Do not substitute the club’s regular Nyon teaching venues for either event.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified historical Signy activity includes 31 January–1 February 2025 and 30–31 January 2026. The 2025 report identifies Centre commercial de Signy; the 2026 invitation explicitly confirms the same venue. The club’s 2026 bulletin calls Signy an annual tournament. This supports recurring local activity, not a rotating national conference or an automatic 2027/2028 date. Marchissy 2027 is a separately named programme on the originally intended Signy date; formal series continuity is unresolved.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown; not demonstrably open. The seed section headed “Accommodation Near the Venue” lists every one of these hotels: Base Nyon; Hotel Real Nyon; B&B Hotel Nyon. Its descriptions are “Serviced accommodation near Nyon station”, “Central lakeside hotel”, and “Road-access option on the edge of town.” These are third-party nearby suggestions, not organizer-appointed hotels, room blocks, or booking commitments. No official housing bureau, host hotel, negotiated allocation, accommodation RFP, peak rooms, or room nights was found in the reviewed event notices. The official Marchissy notice says “Il n’est pas possible de jouer sans manger” — mandatory dining, not mandatory lodging.
findings.organizationStructure: Cercle d’échecs de Nyon is a membership chess club with annual subscriptions and an elected-role-style committee listing president, treasurer, secretary and activity leads. Treat the club as event organizer, not as a commercial PCO/DMC or a hotel. No separate agency or housing intermediary was identified in the reviewed notices. MyChess and Chessmates are listing sources, not evidenced event buyers.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The related Marchissy event already requires dining, and a named restaurant is reported as its playing site: current-edition catering/meeting capture should therefore not be assumed. The three seed-listed Nyon hotels are alternatives, not proven incumbents. The club bulletin describes Signy’s usual Saturday capacity as approximately 160 players; its 2025 results report 76 Friday entrants and 174 Saturday entrants, described as 250 total. These are historical participation figures, potentially overlapping across days, not 250 unique overnight guests. Historical playing-space pressure is not evidence of hotel overflow or displaced room demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send David Lugeon a concise clarification at the organizer-published davidlugeon@hotmail.com (without the dot appearing in the third-party listing). Ask whether the 29 January blitz exists, how Échecs et mets relates to Signy, whether Auberge LaMarmite is final, and whether any nonlocal players/officials need accommodation. Request a referral to the actual accommodation decision-maker and involve Jean-Paul Palau for adult activities if appropriate. Only after demand and transport are confirmed offer an appropriately sized optional lodging arrangement; separately explore a future workshop/meeting with F&B. Do not hold inventory or issue a 20–120-room proposal on the current evidence.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Not sales-qualified as a room-block opportunity. The 29–30 January seed weekend lacks official verification; the confirmed related 30 January Marchissy programme has a published dining requirement and a secondary-source named venue. Accommodation status remains unknown, not committed elsewhere and not confirmed open. Any optional lodging discussion must first establish nonlocal attendees and an acceptable Founex-to-Marchissy transfer plan.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship opportunity only. Annual Signy recurrence is documented, but no verified future rotating host programme, open hotel search or 2028 edition was found. Ask whether the club would consider a future standalone training day or chess-and-dining event in Founex; treat this as a sales hypothesis, not an announced event or recurring room block. Do not use historical Centre commercial de Signy attendance as future YOTEL demand.
